notes: Segment ministries-b3 covers MEA, Law & Justice, Personnel/PG&Pensions, Parliamentary Affairs and Cooperation. Office-holders cross-checked primarily against the official Cabinet Secretariat 'List of Council of Ministers with Portfolios (As on 23.06.2026)' (cabsec.gov.in) plus current Wikipedia revisions and official department pages fetched 2026-09-25. No cabinet reshuffle was confirmed as officially announced between 23.06.2026 and the as-of date, despite press speculation in Aug-Sep 2026; if a reshuffle occurred after this research, minister holder fields here may be stale. Budget figures are intentionally omitted (owned by the union-budget segment). CBI (in-cbi) is defined here per explicit task instruction despite being an investigative agency; ITAT and CAT are judiciary-owned and referenced only by ID, not defined; CVC/CIC/Lokpal are regulator-owned and not referenced/defined here. Known gaps (also flagged per-record via low confidence + inline notes folded into this list): in-ncel; in-ncol; in-bbssl; in-pos-dg-icwa; in-pos-establishment-officer; in-pos-md-ncdc. NCEL/NCOL/BBSSL and CRCS leadership and NCDC's Managing Director could not be confirmed live this session (Wikipedia has no dedicated pages for these newer cooperatives and ncdc.in's officer-list page did not resolve in English); their existence, legal basis (Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002 / NCDC Act, 1962) and general remit are well-documented public record and are included with medium/low confidence rather than omitted, per the 'still include the position, mark low confidence' instruction. Karmayogi Bharat SPV's CEO and DoPT's Establishment Officer are likewise unresolved. Wikipedia API (en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php) rate-limited this session's curl calls after ~2 requests; WebFetch was used as the fallback for most Wikipedia lookups thereafter. WebSearch quota (200 calls, shared across concurrently running segment agents) was exhausted early in this session; remaining research relied on WebFetch + curl only. ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION PASS (2026-09-25): re-checked 49 named positions/holders against fresh live sources (mea.gov.in/secretaries, icwa.in, ris.org.in, a locally re-parsed cabsec.gov.in council-of-ministers PDF, and current Wikipedia revisions fetched directly rather than trusted from the original citations alone). Found the great majority of holders correct as recorded; made 28 corrective edits (mostly added/strengthened sources and precised since-dates) and flagged genuine unresolved conflicts rather than guessing: in-pos-dg-icwa (vacancy corroborated, Raghavan is explicitly 'former' on ICWA's own site), in-pos-chairperson-cbc (conflicting live signal between a current-affairs source and Zainulbhai's still-unupdated Wikipedia infobox), and in-pos-secretary-darpg/-doppw (single LinkedIn source could not be independently reconfirmed this session). See the top-level 'verification' block for the full corrections/additions/unresolvedGaps log.

entities.name: Ministry of External Affairs
entities.description: Conducts India's foreign relations and diplomacy, runs India's missions abroad, negotiates treaties, and delivers consular, passport and visa services to citizens and the diaspora.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Consular, Passport, Visa and Overseas Indian Affairs (CPV) Division
entities.description: Issues Indian passports and visas, handles consular protection of citizens abroad and overseas Indian affairs, delivered nationwide through Passport Seva Kendras under the Passport Seva Programme (a public-private partnership launched 2010).

entities.name: Office of the Protector General of Emigrants
entities.description: Regulates and grants emigration clearance for Indian workers going to notified (ECR) countries, and oversees the network of Protectors of Emigrants at major cities/airports, to protect migrant workers from exploitation.

entities.name: Indian Council for Cultural Relations
entities.description: India's cultural diplomacy body: runs cultural centres abroad, funds scholarships for foreign students in India, sponsors cultural exchange and artiste tours to project India's soft power.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society; functions under MEA administrative control

entities.name: Indian Council of World Affairs
entities.description: India's oldest foreign-policy think tank; conducts research, dialogues and publications on international relations and is declared an Institution of National Importance.
entities.legalBasis: Indian Council of World Affairs Act, 2001
entities.hq: Sapru House, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi

entities.name: Research and Information System for Developing Countries
entities.description: An MEA-funded autonomous policy-research think tank on international economic issues, South-South cooperation, trade and development for developing countries.

entities.name: Nalanda University
entities.description: An international postgraduate research university at Rajgir, Bihar, revived as a symbol of India's civilisational links to Asia; supported by member countries of the East Asia Summit, with the President of India as Visitor.

entities.name: Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service
entities.description: Trains newly recruited Indian Foreign Service officers and runs induction/mid-career diplomatic training courses; renamed in 2020 for former EAM Sushma Swaraj.

entities.name: Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation Programme
entities.description: India's flagship international capacity-building and development-partnership programme, offering training slots, projects, consultancy and disaster relief to partner developing countries since 1964.

entities.name: Indian Diplomatic Missions Abroad (aggregate)
entities.description: Aggregate entity representing India's network of resident embassies, high commissions, permanent missions and consulates abroad, each headed by an Ambassador/High Commissioner reporting to MEA.
entities.legalBasis: Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, 1961 (domestic implementation via MEA)

entities.name: Ministry of Law and Justice
entities.description: Manages India's legal affairs, drafts central legislation, administers the justice-delivery system, and advises other ministries on law, through three departments: Legal Affairs, Legislative, and Justice.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Legal Affairs
entities.description: Advises ministries on legal questions, drafts contracts and treaties, and superintends the offices of the Attorney General, Solicitor General and government law officers.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Legislative Department
entities.description: Drafts principal central legislation (Bills and major subordinate legislation), and administers the Official Languages Act translation of central Acts and Rules into Hindi.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Official Language Wing, Legislative Department
entities.description: Translates central Acts, Ordinances and statutory rules/orders into Hindi (the authoritative Hindi text) and maintains the standard legal-Hindi lexicon used across government.

entities.name: Department of Justice
entities.description: Administers judicial infrastructure funding, judges' appointments processing, and centrally sponsored schemes to speed up justice delivery (e-Courts, fast-track courts, legal aid support).
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; separated from Ministry of Home Affairs, 1 January 2010

entities.name: National Mission for Justice Delivery and Legal Reforms
entities.description: Department of Justice mission to reduce case pendency and delays by improving judicial infrastructure, human resources and case/court management, and by focusing on vulnerable litigants.

entities.name: eCourts Mission Mode Project
entities.description: Department of Justice-funded ICT-enablement of India's district and subordinate courts (case information systems, e-filing, video-conferencing), implemented in coordination with the e-Committee of the Supreme Court.
entities.legalBasis: National Policy and Action Plan for ICT Implementation in the Indian Judiciary (2005)

entities.name: Law Commission of India (23rd)
entities.description: Government-appointed expert body that reviews and recommends reform of Indian laws; the 23rd Commission was constituted for a three-year term to examine matters referred by the government.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution constituting the 23rd Law Commission

entities.name: National Judicial Academy
entities.description: Trains judges, court staff and other justice-system stakeholders and conducts research on judicial administration; governed by a Council chaired by the Chief Justice of India, funded via the Department of Justice.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860

entities.name: Bar Council of India
entities.description: Statutory self-regulatory body for the legal profession: sets standards for legal education, enrols and disciplines advocates, and lays down professional conduct rules across India.

entities.name: Indian Law Institute
entities.description: Deemed-university socio-legal research and training institute opposite the Supreme Court; publishes the Journal of the Indian Law Institute and runs postgraduate law programmes.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860; deemed university under UGC Act, 1956

entities.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
entities.description: Runs the Union's civil-service HR system (recruitment policy, IAS/central-service cadre management, training, vigilance-linked appointments), public-grievance redress, administrative reform, and pension policy for central government employees, through three departments.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Personnel and Training
entities.description: The Union government's central personnel agency: sets civil-service recruitment, promotion, training, service-conduct and cadre-management rules for the IAS and central civil services, and oversees the CBI.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances
entities.description: Drives administrative-reform policy (e-governance, Sevottam service standards) and runs the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) for citizen complaints against government.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare
entities.description: Frames pension policy for central government civil pensioners (including the National Pension System's rules for government employees) and handles pensioner grievances.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Central Bureau of Investigation
entities.description: India's premier federal investigative agency, probing corruption by central government officials, major frauds/economic offences, and serious/inter-state crimes referred by courts or state consent.

entities.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration
entities.description: The all-India foundation-course and induction-training academy for the IAS and allied civil services, at Mussoorie.

entities.name: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management
entities.description: Central training institute for Union government employees: orientation, financial management, behavioural and secretariat-procedure courses, plus consultancy.

entities.name: Staff Selection Commission
entities.description: Recruits staff for Group B and Group C (non-technical) posts in Union government ministries, departments and subordinate offices through nationwide competitive examinations.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution constituting the SSC (1975/1977)

entities.name: Mission Karmayogi (Karmayogi Bharat)
entities.description: National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building: a competency-based, technology-enabled civil-service training reform run through the iGOT Karmayogi digital learning platform and delivered by the not-for-profit Karmayogi Bharat SPV.

entities.name: Capacity Building Commission
entities.description: Oversees and harmonises civil-service training institutions and curricula government-wide under Mission Karmayogi, and advises DoPT on capacity-building policy.

entities.name: National Centre for Good Governance
entities.description: Trains Indian and partner-country (e.g. Bangladesh, Maldives, Bhutan, other developing nations) civil servants in governance reform, e-governance and public policy under DARPG's administrative oversight.

entities.name: Indian Institute of Public Administration
entities.description: Autonomous research and training body for public administration; trains civil servants and publishes the Indian Journal of Public Administration.

entities.name: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs
entities.description: Coordinates government business in Parliament: schedules sessions in consultation with the presiding officers, tracks legislative business, follows up on assurances given by ministers on the floor of the House, and liaises between the government and the Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha secretariats.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Ministry of Cooperation
entities.description: Provides a separate administrative, legal and policy framework to strengthen India's cooperative movement (credit, dairy, sugar, fertiliser, housing, marketing and export cooperatives), a subject that is otherwise primarily state-level.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies
entities.description: Registers and regulates Multi-State Cooperative Societies (societies whose objects/operations span more than one state), including approving their bye-laws, amalgamations and winding-up.

entities.name: National Cooperative Development Corporation
entities.description: Statutory corporation that plans and finances programmes for the production, processing, marketing, storage, export and import of agricultural produce, foodstuffs and other cooperative-sector goods.

entities.name: National Cooperative Exports Limited
entities.description: Multi-state apex cooperative society to aggregate and export cooperative-sector produce (agri-commodities, handicrafts and more) on behalf of member cooperatives, aiming to boost farmer/cooperative incomes via exports.

entities.name: National Cooperative Organics Limited
entities.description: Multi-state apex cooperative society to produce, certify and market organic products (branded 'Bharat Organics') to give farmers a structured, unadulterated-organic supply chain and better prices.

entities.name: Bhartiya Beej Sahkari Samiti Limited
entities.description: National multi-state cooperative seed society to produce, procure and market quality/certified seeds through cooperatives, reducing farmer dependence on private seed supply.

entities.name: Tribhuvan Sahkari University
entities.description: India's first cooperative university (formerly the Institute of Rural Management Anand, IRMA), redesignated by Act of Parliament to train professional managers for cooperatives and rural producer organisations.

entities.name: Passport Seva Programme
entities.description: MEA's flagship e-governance programme (run in public-private partnership) that digitised and decentralised passport issuance through a national network of Passport Seva Kendras and Post Office Passport Seva Kendras, under the CPV Division.
